description: This source file contains functions for exporting behavioral observation data in various formats such as tabular, aggregated, and sequence data. It also includes utilities for handling external file formats, exporting sequences, and interfacing with databases. The code is tailored to the BORIS software framework for behavioral research, with functions supporting details like media duration, behavioral sequences, and different output formats.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] export_events_jwatcher( parameters: dict, obsId: str, observation: list, ethogram: dict, file_name: str, output_format: str )
methods.description: Exports events data for given subjects into .dat format compatible with JWatcher, including creating associated .fmf, .faf, and .fmp files.

methods.name: Tuple[bool,str] export_tabular_events( pj: dict, parameters: dict, obs_id: str, observation: dict, ethogram: dict, file_name: str, output_format: str )
methods.description: Exports behavioral events for a specific observation into various tabular formats such as CSV, TSV, HTML, or pandas DataFrame, with detailed information per event.

methods.name: tuple dataset_write(dataset: tablib.Dataset, file_name: str, output_format: str, dtype: dict = {})
methods.description: Writes a tablib dataset to a file in the specified format, supporting CSV, TSV, HTML, Excel, ODS, pandas pickle, or RDS.

methods.name: Tuple[tablib.Dataset,int] export_aggregated_events(pj: dict, parameters: dict, obsId: str, force_number_modifiers: int = 0)
methods.description: Exports aggregated (summary) events data for an observation, including database interaction, handling time intervals, and modifiers.

methods.name: str events_to_behavioral_sequences(pj, obs_id: str, subj: str, parameters: dict, behav_seq_separator: str)
methods.description: Generates a string representing behavioral sequences for a subject during an observation.

methods.name: str events_to_behavioral_sequences_all_subj(pj, obs_id: str, subjects_list: list, parameters: dict, behav_seq_separator: str)
methods.description: Generates behavioral sequences for all subjects within an observation, including subject identifiers in sequences.

methods.name: str events_to_timed_behavioral_sequences( pj: dict, obs_id: str, subject: str, parameters: dict, precision: float, behav_seq_separator: str )
methods.description: Creates time-scanned behavioral sequences for a subject, considering a specified scan interval (precision).

methods.name: observation_to_behavioral_sequences(pj, selected_observations, parameters, behaviors_separator, separated_subjects, timed, file_name)
methods.description: Exports behavioral sequences or data summaries for selected observations into a file, supporting detailed sequence or sequence per subject output.
